Force-enables or disables features from the firmware FeatureConfig
Standard stabilization in video runs the horizon-levelling mode on the main camera. Experimental: the firmware does not offer this mode
The logo in the frame watermark, the T* colour button and the portrait formulas. The tweak sets the feature flags itself
Removes the grey scrim behind the notification shade so the desktop stays visible
The Restart button in the power menu restarts system_server only (~10 s instead of ~60 s). All LSPosed hooks are re-applied. Requires root
Displays real-time wattage (W), current (mA), voltage (V) and battery temperature (°C) while charging on the lock screen
Removes the separator lines between items in Settings lists
Replace text values on the About phone screen: model, firmware, IMEI, etc. Set values in the tweak settings
Leave empty to keep the original value. Changes apply after reopening the About phone screen.
Media volume changes in 2% steps (50 levels) instead of the stock step count
Replaces the animation in the About phone card: your own video or a picture stretched to the full banner
DOOM in the About phone card

The original DOOM (PureDOOM, shareware doom1.wad) runs natively and replaces the card animation. The engine starts while the card is on screen and stops when you leave it. The setting applies after reopening the About phone screen.
USE — open doors · in menu: Esc
Vol+ / Vol- — shoot / use · hold Vol- — menu
Logs big-folder grid and preview slot values to logcat tag HonorToolFolder. Does not change anything
Replaces IMEI, MEID and device ID shown on the About phone and SIM status screens with 15 zeros. Only affects the Settings app display
Not selected — the stock animation is used

The video plays in a square 360×360 view and is scaled automatically, so for a perfect fit prepare a square video beforehand. You can also push a file manually: adb push file.mp4 /sdcard/Download/honortool/honortool_anim.mp4. Changes apply without reboot.
The stock video is hidden and your picture is stretched to the full card width (720×360 crop). The picture can be changed without reboot — reopen the About phone screen.
0% makes the shade background fully transparent, 100% keeps the original dark grey at full strength. Changes apply without reboot.
Done. Force stop Settings to see the picture
One finger to move, two fingers or the slider to zoom. The card will show exactly what is inside the frame.
